meta.name: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
meta.description: Saku Chitose is a student at Fujishi High School, the most prestigious school in Fukui Prefecture. Outstanding in class, on the field, and in his social life, Saku attracts attention, good and bad. Naturally, he is surrounded by a circle of friends anyone would be happy to have. Now in the spring of his second year, with a new class, Saku is asked to help a shut-in classmate return to school life.

videos.overview: Saku Chitose is an elite student who has an unexpected wrench thrown into his beautiful life.
